executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Enterprise SSD, Server DRAM / RDIMM and HBM are currently among the tightest areas. The Daily Check from 17 August 2026 reviewed eight relevant current reports and found no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and better yields may provide relief, but will reach the market only after a delay. Supply assurance, alternative BOMs and early procurement therefore remain critical for buyers.
